metadata.title: The Well-Tempered clAIvier
metadata.subtitle: Fugue VII in E-flat major (a 4): Fuga a due cori
metadata.instrument: Keyboard: two choirs of two voices (Coro II right hand, Coro I left hand)

markers.label: Coro II (soprano, alto): the mirror exposition
The choirs meet: entries a bar apart
Episode: the lament bass, tenor and soprano
The quarrel: B-flat (Coro I) against A-flat (Coro II), a bar each
The joke: augmentation, interrupted by diminution
Coro I gives up: heads a beat apart
Stretto a 4: the levels fall by fifths to the tonic
Coda: ritornello, then "Wachet auf" in the tenor

subject_entries.label: Coro II: inversion (alto; the mirror of b1)
Coro II: inverted answer (soprano, A-flat; the mirror of b3)
inversion on F (soprano), a bar later
inversion on D (alto, g minor, turning to B-flat)
Coro II: inverted head in A-flat
Coro II: the subject in diminution (mocking Coro I)
Coro II sings the head rectus (g)
Coro I sings the head inverted (g)
Coro II sings the rectus head, up to the climax
ritornello: the inversion in diminution (as in the prelude)
Coro I finishes its augmentation (F E-flat D)
Coro II: the head, upside down
